item.title: Microplastics may be more dangerous than we thought. Scientists just discovered why
item.description: Microplastics may be doing something far more dangerous than simply accumulating in our bodies. item.title: The call of the seamount: Two new armored tardigrades described in the Atlantic
item.description: An international team led by researchers from Senckenberg am Meer in Wilhelmshaven has described two new species of marine tardigrades.
